description: Clinical assertions: one ST line per statement a clinical document makes, with what kind of statement it is, whether it is affirmed or negated, how certain, about whom, when, the value if there is one, and a pointer to the exact words that support it. The lines are the record; the document stays the evidence.

act.OBS: observed, examined or measured by the author
act.RPT: reported by the patient or a third party, not verified by the author
act.ASSESS: the author's assessment, diagnosis or impression
act.ORD: ordered or requested: a test, a referral, an action asked of someone else
act.DONE: carried out: a procedure, treatment or action that happened
act.RX: a medicine prescribed, continued or changed by the author; chg says how
act.PLAN: the author's intention or a scheduled next step
act.ADV: advice or information given to the patient or carer

cert.HYPO: hypothetical: a warning, a risk or a possibility discussed

time.CUR: current at the time of the document, including ongoing conditions
time.PAST: before the document: history, a past event, resolved
time.FUT: after the document: planned or expected

chg.CHG: changed in another way: route, formulation, frequency

who.OTH: another source: a laboratory, another service, unknown

slots.desc: what kind of statement this is
where the words are: doc:<id>#l<n> or doc:<id>#l<n>-<m>, the numbered line(s) of the source; exactly one per line
the measured or reported value as written, no units (7.2, 148/92, 3/10)
unit of res as written, no spaces (mmol/L, mmHg, kg, %)
medicine dose as written, no spaces (500mg, 1g, 2puffs)
what happened to a medicine at this encounter
body site or laterality, lowercase, hyphens (left-knee, right-iliac-fossa)
who said or did it; omit when it is the author
date or interval as written, no spaces (2009, 20260914, 6w, 3d, 10y)

item_kinds.sym: symptom, sign, examination or investigation finding
item_kinds.meas: measurement with a value: vital sign, test result, score

translation.note: The lines are the record. One ST line per statement the document makes, never merged: item=<kind>:<concept> with the concept in lowercase hyphenated words, generic names, no abbreviations; act pol cert subj time on every line; exactly one src= naming the numbered line(s) the words are on; the tail is the shortest verbatim quote from those lines that supports the statement, nothing else. A statement that corrects an earlier one carries re=<id of the line it replaces>. A statement made twice gets one line, the first occurrence. Checked in code: src line exists, the tail is found in it, one src per line, item kind is one of the ten.
